$comment: Generated by pnpm a11y (scripts/a11y.ts) — do not hand-edit.

checks.label: Contract
checks.how: The contract’s a11y section names the role and the WCAG criteria, and an interactive component lists its keys.

checks.label: Keys tested
checks.how: A play test presses every key the contract lists.

checks.label: Focus return
checks.how: When Escape closes something, a play test asserts where focus lands.

checks.label: Keyboard
checks.how: Those play tests pass in a real browser.

checks.label: axe
checks.how: axe finds no violation in any story, light and dark (contrast is its own check).

checks.label: Contrast
checks.how: Text contrast AA in every story, in light AND dark.

checks.label: Focus visible
checks.how: Tabbing through each story, every stop looks different focused vs unfocused (pixel comparison), light and dark.

checks.label: Target size
checks.how: Every pointer target is at least 24×24 px, or has a 24 px circle free of other targets.

checks.label: Reflow
checks.how: At 320 px wide nothing scrolls sideways. Layout components only — a component story’s demo box isn’t a page.

checks.label: Screen reader
checks.how: The accessibility tree of its stories (Playwright ariaSnapshot) contains the role the contract promises.

checks.label: AI visual
checks.how: An AI look at screenshots: color-only meaning, non-text contrast, label in name, clipped text, focus clarity. Advisory — a person confirms.

checks.label: Human review
checks.how: A person used it with a real screen reader and recorded it in the contract.
